### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

"""
Optimal Power Flow (OPF) Solver for AC-feasible base case
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Any
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')


class OPFSolver:
    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver using the mathematical model"""

    def __init__(self, network_file: str):
        """Initialize OPF solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.network = json.load(f)

        self.base_mva = self.network.get('baseMVA', 100.0)
        self._parse_network()
        self._initialize_variables()

    def _parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data from JSON"""
        # Parse buses
        self.buses = {}
        for bus_data in self.network.get('bus', []):
            bus_id = int(bus_data[0])
            self.buses[bus_id] = {
                'type': int(bus_data[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=ref
                'pd': bus_data[2],  # active load (MW)
                'qd': bus_data[3],  # reactive load (MVAr)
                'gs': bus_data[4],  # shunt conductance (MW)
                'bs': bus_data[5],  # shunt susceptance (MVAr)
                'area': int(bus_data[6]),
                'vm': bus_data[9],  # voltage magnitude (pu)
                'va': bus_data[10],  # voltage angle (deg)
                'vmax': bus_data[11],  # max voltage (pu)
                'vmin': bus_data[12],  # min voltage (pu)
            }

        self.n_buses = len(self.buses)
        self.bus_list = sorted(self.buses.keys())
        self.bus_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(self.bus_list)}

        # Parse generators
        self.generators = {}
        for gen_data in self.network.get('gen', []):
            bus_id = int(gen_data[0])
            if bus_id not in self.generators:
                self.generators[bus_id] = []

            gen_id = len(self.generators[bus_id])
            self.generators[bus_id].append({
                'id': gen_id,
                'bus': bus_id,
                'pg': gen_data[1],  # real power
                'qg': gen_data[2],  # reactive power
                'qmax': gen_data[3],  # max reactive
                'qmin': gen_data[4],  # min reactive
                'vg': gen_data[5],  # voltage setpoint
                'mbase': gen_data[6],  # MVA base
                'status': int(gen_data[7]),  # status
                'pmax': gen_data[8],  # max real power
                'pmin': gen_data[9],  # min real power
                'pc1': gen_data[10] if len(gen_data) > 10 else 0,  # cost coeff
                'pc2': gen_data[11] if len(gen_data) > 11 else 0,
                'qc1max': gen_data[12] if len(gen_data) > 12 else gen_data[3],
                'qc1min': gen_data[13] if len(gen_data) > 13 else gen_data[4],
                'qc2max': gen_data[14] if len(gen_data) > 14 else gen_data[3],
                'qc2min': gen_data[15] if len(gen_data) > 15 else gen_data[4],
                'ramp_agc': gen_data[16] if len(gen_data) > 16 else 0,
                'ramp_10': gen_data[17] if len(gen_data) > 17 else 0,
                'ramp_30': gen_data[18] if len(gen_data) > 18 else 0,
                'ramp_q': gen_data[19] if len(gen_data) > 19 else 0,
                'apf': gen_data[20] if len(gen_data) > 20 else 0,
            })

        # Parse branches
        self.branches = []
        for branch_data in self.network.get('branch', []):
            branch = {
                'from_bus': int(branch_data[0]),
                'to_bus': int(branch_data[1]),
                'r': branch_data[2],  # resistance
                's': branch_data[3],  # reactance
                'b': branch_data[4],  # susceptance
                'rateA': branch_data[5] if branch_data[5] > 0 else 999,  # MVA limit
                'rateB': branch_data[6] if branch_data[6] > 0 else 999,
                'rateC': branch_data[7] if branch_data[7] > 0 else 999,
                'ratio': branch_data[8] if len(branch_data) > 8 else 0,  # turns ratio
                'angle': branch_data[9] if len(branch_data) > 9 else 0,  # phase shift (deg)
                'status': int(branch_data[10]) if len(branch_data) > 10 else 1,
                'angmin': branch_data[11] if len(branch_data) > 11 else -60,
                'angmax': branch_data[12] if len(branch_data) > 12 else 60,
            }
            if branch['status'] == 1:
                self.branches.append(branch)

        self.n_branches = len(self.branches)

        # Parse generator cost data if available
        self.gen_costs = {}
        for cost_data in self.network.get('gencost', []):
            gen_idx = int(cost_data[0]) - 1
            if cost_data[1] == 2:  # polynomial cost
                n_coeffs = int(cost_data[2])
                coeffs = cost_data[3:][:n_coeffs]
                # Store as quadratic: [c2, c1, c0]
                if n_coeffs >= 3:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = coeffs[-3:]
                elif n_coeffs == 2:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = [0, coeffs[-2], coeffs[-1]]
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = [0, 0, coeffs[-1] if n_coeffs > 0 else 0]

    def _initialize_variables(self):
        """Initialize optimization variables"""
        # Flatten generator list
        self.gen_list = []
        gen_map = {}
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            if bus_id in self.generators:
                for gen in self.generators[bus_id]:
                    gen_idx = len(self.gen_list)
                    self.gen_list.append((bus_id, gen['id']))
                    gen_map[(bus_id, gen['id'])] = gen_idx

        self.gen_map = gen_map
        self.n_gens = len(self.gen_list)

        # Reference buses (slack buses)
        self.ref_buses = [bid for bid in self.bus_list if self.buses[bid]['type'] == 3]
        if not self.ref_buses:
            self.ref_buses = [self.bus_list[0]]

    def solve(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        # Initial point: use bus voltages as init, generators at mid-range
        x0 = self._get_initial_point()

        # Bounds
        bounds = self._get_bounds()

        # Constraints
        constraints = self._get_constraints()

        # Objective function
        def objective(x):
            return self._objective(x)

        # Solve
        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6}
        )

        return self._extract_solution(result, x0)

    def _get_initial_point(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """Get initial point for optimization"""
        # Variables: [pg_0, qg_0, ..., pg_n, qg_n, vm_0, va_0, ..., vm_n, va_n]
        x = []

        # Generator powers
        for bus_id, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            gen = self.generators[bus_id][gen_id]
            # Start at mid-range
            p_mid = (gen['pmin'] + gen['pmax']) / 2
            q_mid = (gen['qmin'] + gen['qmax']) / 2
            x.append(p_mid)
            x.append(q_mid)

        # Bus voltages
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            x.append(bus['vm'])  # voltage magnitude
            x.append(bus['va'])  # voltage angle

        return np.array(x)

    def _get_bounds(self) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:
        """Get variable bounds"""
        bounds = []

        # Generator power bounds
        for bus_id, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            gen = self.generators[bus_id][gen_id]
            bounds.append((gen['pmin'], gen['pmax']))  # Pg
            bounds.append((gen['qmin'], gen['qmax']))  # Qg

        # Voltage bounds
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            bounds.append((bus['vmin'], bus['vmax']))  # Vm
            bounds.append((-180, 180))  # Va (degrees)

        return bounds

    def _get_constraints(self) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get constraint functions"""
        constraints = []

        # Slack bus angle = 0
        for ref_bus in self.ref_buses:
            bus_idx = self.bus_idx[ref_bus]
            var_idx = self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2 + 1

            def slack_constraint(x, var_idx=var_idx):
                return x[var_idx]

            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': slack_constraint
            })

        # Power balance constraints
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            def power_balance(x, bus_id=bus_id):
                return self._power_balance_constraint(x, bus_id)

            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': power_balance
            })

        return constraints

    def _power_balance_constraint(self, x: np.ndarray, bus_id: int) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """
        Power balance constraint: Pg - Pd = Pflow
        Returns both real and reactive power mismatch
        """
        bus_idx = self.bus_idx[bus_id]

        # Get generator power at this bus
        pg = 0.0
        qg = 0.0
        for bid, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            if bid == bus_id:
                gen_idx = self.gen_map[(bid, gen_id)]
                pg += x[gen_idx * 2]
                qg += x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]

        # Get load
        pd = self.buses[bus_id]['pd']
        qd = self.buses[bus_id]['qd']

        # Get shunt
        gs = self.buses[bus_id]['gs']
        bs = self.buses[bus_id]['bs']
        vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2]

        p_shunt = gs * vm * vm
        q_shunt = -bs * vm * vm

        # Get voltage
        va = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2 + 1])
        v = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate branch flows
        p_flow = 0.0
        q_flow = 0.0

        for branch in self.branches:
            from_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['from_bus'])
            to_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['to_bus'])

            if from_idx is None or to_idx is None:
                continue

            if branch['from_bus'] == bus_id:
                # Flow from this bus
                vm_to = x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2]
                va_to = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2 + 1])
                v_to = vm_to * np.exp(1j * va_to)

                # Series admittance
                z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
                y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
                b = branch['b']

                # Shunt at from end
                yc_from = 1j * b / 2

                # Tap ratio
                t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                if branch['angle'] != 0:
                    t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

                # Power flow from->to
                v_norm = v / t if t != 0 else v
                s = (y + yc_from) * (v_norm * np.conj(v_norm)) - y * v_norm * np.conj(v_to)

                p_flow += s.real
                q_flow += s.imag

            elif branch['to_bus'] == bus_id:
                # Flow to this bus
                vm_from = x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2]
                va_from = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2 + 1])
                v_from = vm_from * np.exp(1j * va_from)

                # Series admittance
                z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
                y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
                b = branch['b']

                # Shunt at to end
                yc_to = 1j * b / 2

                # Tap ratio
                t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                if branch['angle'] != 0:
                    t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

                # Power flow to<-from
                s = (y + yc_to) * (v * np.conj(v)) - y * v * np.conj(v_from / t)

                p_flow += s.real
                q_flow += s.imag

        # Balance equation: Pg - Pd - Pshunt = Pflow
        # Return as single value (prioritize real power)
        p_mismatch = pg - pd - p_shunt - p_flow
        q_mismatch = qg - qd - q_shunt - q_flow

        # Return weighted sum to keep both in check
        return p_mismatch * 1.0 + q_mismatch * 0.1

    def _objective(self, x: np.ndarray) -> float:
        """Objective function: minimize generation cost"""
        cost = 0.0
        gen_counter = 0

        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            if bus_id not in self.generators:
                continue

            for gen in self.generators[bus_id]:
                pg = x[gen_counter * 2]

                # Get cost coefficients
                cost_key = gen_counter
                if cost_key in self.gen_costs:
                    c2, c1, c0 = self.gen_costs[cost_key]
                else:
                    # Default: linear cost
                    c2, c1, c0 = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0

                cost += c2 * pg * pg + c1 * pg + c0

                gen_counter += 1

        return cost

    def _extract_solution(self, opt_result, x0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Extract solution from optimizer result"""
        x = opt_result.x if opt_result.success else x0

        # Extract voltages
        voltages = {}
        for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_list):
            vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
            va = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2 + 1]
            voltages[bus_id] = {'vm': vm, 'va': va}

        # Extract generator dispatch
        gen_dispatch = {}
        for gen_idx, (bus_id, gen_id) in enumerate(self.gen_list):
            pg = x[gen_idx * 2]
            qg = x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]
            if bus_id not in gen_dispatch:
                gen_dispatch[bus_id] = []
            gen_dispatch[bus_id].append({'pg': pg, 'qg': qg})

        # Calculate summary statistics
        total_cost = self._objective(x)
        total_gen_p = sum(pg for pg, _ in [(x[i * 2], x[i * 2 + 1]) for i in range(self.n_gens)])
        total_gen_q = sum(qg for _, qg in [(x[i * 2], x[i * 2 + 1]) for i in range(self.n_gens)])

        total_load_p = sum(self.buses[bid]['pd'] for bid in self.bus_list)
        total_load_q = sum(self.buses[bid]['qd'] for bid in self.bus_list)

        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        # Calculate most loaded branches
        most_loaded = self._get_most_loaded_branches(x)

        # Feasibility check
        feasibility = self._check_feasibility(x, opt_result)

        return {
            'success': opt_result.success,
            'x': x,
            'voltages': voltages,
            'gen_dispatch': gen_dispatch,
            'total_cost': total_cost,
            'total_gen_p': total_gen_p,
            'total_gen_q': total_gen_q,
            'total_load_p': total_load_p,
            'total_load_q': total_load_q,
            'total_losses_p': total_losses_p,
            'most_loaded': most_loaded,
            'feasibility': feasibility,
        }

    def _get_most_loaded_branches(self, x: np.ndarray, top_n: int = 10) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get most loaded branches"""
        branch_loadings = []

        for branch in self.branches:
            from_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['from_bus'])
            to_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['to_bus'])

            if from_idx is None or to_idx is None:
                continue

            vm_from = x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2]
            va_from = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2 + 1])
            v_from = vm_from * np.exp(1j * va_from)

            vm_to = x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2]
            va_to = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2 + 1])
            v_to = vm_to * np.exp(1j * va_to)

            # Calculate power flow
            z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
            y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
            b = branch['b']
            yc_from = 1j * b / 2

            t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
            if branch['angle'] != 0:
                t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

            v_norm = v_from / t if t != 0 else v_from
            s_from = (y + yc_from) * (v_norm * np.conj(v_norm)) - y * v_norm * np.conj(v_to)
            s_mva_from = np.abs(s_from)

            # Calculate return flow
            yc_to = 1j * b / 2
            s_to = (y + yc_to) * (v_to * np.conj(v_to)) - y * v_to * np.conj(v_from / t)
            s_mva_to = np.abs(s_to)

            limit = branch['rateA']
            loading_pct = max(s_mva_from, s_mva_to) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

            branch_loadings.append({
                'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
                'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': s_mva_from,
                'flow_to_MVA': s_mva_to,
                'limit_MVA': limit,
            })

        # Sort by loading percentage and return top N
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        return branch_loadings[:top_n]

    def _check_feasibility(self, x: np.ndarray, opt_result) -> Dict:
        """Check solution feasibility"""
        max_p_mismatch = 0.0
        max_q_mismatch = 0.0
        max_voltage_viol = 0.0
        max_branch_overload = 0.0

        # Check voltage limits
        for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_list):
            vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            if vm < bus['vmin']:
                max_voltage_viol = max(max_voltage_viol, bus['vmin'] - vm)
            elif vm > bus['vmax']:
                max_voltage_viol = max(max_voltage_viol, vm - bus['vmax'])

        # Check power balance
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            pg = 0.0
            qg = 0.0
            for bid, gen_id in self.gen_list:
                if bid == bus_id:
                    gen_idx = self.gen_map[(bid, gen_id)]
                    pg += x[gen_idx * 2]
                    qg += x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]

            pd = self.buses[bus_id]['pd']
            qd = self.buses[bus_id]['qd']

            max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, abs(pg - pd))
            max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, abs(qg - qd))

        # Check branch limits
        for branch_loading in self._get_most_loaded_branches(x, top_n=len(self.branches)):
            if branch_loading['loading_pct'] > 100:
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload,
                                         branch_loading['loading_pct'] - 100)

        return {
            'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
            'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
            'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_voltage_viol, 6),
            'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_branch_overload, 2),
        }


def main():
    """Main function"""
    print("Solving AC Optimal Power Flow...")

    solver = OPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    solution = solver.solve()

    print(f"Solver Status: {'Optimal' if solution['success'] else 'Failed'}")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${solution['total_cost']:.2f}")
    print(f"Total Generation: {solution['total_gen_p']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Load: {solution['total_load_p']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Losses: {solution['total_losses_p']:.2f} MW")

    # Generate report
    report = generate_report(solver, solution)

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\nReport saved to /root/report.json")


def generate_report(solver: OPFSolver, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the final report"""
    x = solution['x']

    # Generators list
    generators = []
    gen_counter = 0
    for bus_id in solver.bus_list:
        if bus_id not in solver.generators:
            continue
        for gen_idx, gen in enumerate(solver.generators[bus_id]):
            pg = x[gen_counter * 2]
            qg = x[gen_counter * 2 + 1]

            generators.append({
                'id': gen['id'],
                'bus': gen['bus'],
                'pg_MW': round(pg, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(qg, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(gen['pmin'], 1),
                'pmax_MW': round(gen['pmax'], 1),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(gen['qmin'], 1),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(gen['qmax'], 1),
            })
            gen_counter += 1

    # Buses list
    buses = []
    for i, bus_id in enumerate(solver.bus_list):
        vm = x[solver.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
        va = x[solver.n_gens * 2 + i * 2 + 1]
        bus = solver.buses[bus_id]

        buses.append({
            'id': bus_id,
            'vm_pu': round(vm, 2),
            'va_deg': round(va, 1),
            'vmin_pu': round(bus['vmin'], 2),
            'vmax_pu': round(bus['vmax'], 2),
        })

    # Most loaded branches
    most_loaded = solution['most_loaded'][:10]  # Top 10
    for branch in most_loaded:
        branch['loading_pct'] = round(branch['loading_pct'], 1)
        branch['flow_from_MVA'] = round(branch['flow_from_MVA'], 1)
        branch['flow_to_MVA'] = round(branch['flow_to_MVA'], 1)
        branch['limit_MVA'] = round(branch['limit_MVA'], 1)

    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(solution['total_cost'], 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(solution['total_load_p'], 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(solution['total_load_q'], 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(solution['total_gen_p'], 2),
            'total_generation_MVAr': round(solution['total_gen_q'], 2),
            'total_losses_MW': round(solution['total_losses_p'], 2),
            'solver_status': 'optimal' if solution['success'] else 'failed',
        },
        'generators': generators,
        'buses': buses,
        'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
        'feasibility_check': solution['feasibility'],
    }

    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver using the mathematical model"""

    def __init__(self, network_file: str):
        """Initialize OPF solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.network = json.load(f)

        self.base_mva = self.network.get('baseMVA', 100.0)
        self._parse_network()
        self._initialize_variables()

    def _parse_network(self):

                'vmin': bus_data[12],  # min voltage (pu)
            }

        self.n_buses = len(self.buses)
        self.bus_list = sorted(self.buses.keys())
        self.bus_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(self.bus_list)}

        # Parse generators
        self.generators = {}

                'id': gen_id,

                'pg': gen_data[1],  # real power
                'qg': gen_data[2],  # reactive power
                'qmax': gen_data[3],  # max reactive
                'qmin': gen_data[4],  # min reactive
                'vg': gen_data[5],  # voltage setpoint
                'mbase': gen_data[6],  # MVA base
                'status': int(gen_data[7]),  # status
                'pmax': gen_data[8],  # max real power
                'pmin': gen_data[9],  # min real power
                'pc1': gen_data[10] if len(gen_data) > 10 else 0,  # cost coeff
                'pc2': gen_data[11] if len(gen_data) > 11 else 0,
                'qc1max': gen_data[12] if len(gen_data) > 12 else gen_data[3],
                'qc1min': gen_data[13] if len(gen_data) > 13 else gen_data[4],
                'qc2max': gen_data[14] if len(gen_data) > 14 else gen_data[3],
                'qc2min': gen_data[15] if len(gen_data) > 15 else gen_data[4],
                'ramp_agc': gen_data[16] if len(gen_data) > 16 else 0,
                'ramp_10': gen_data[17] if len(gen_data) > 17 else 0,
                'ramp_30': gen_data[18] if len(gen_data) > 18 else 0,
                'ramp_q': gen_data[19] if len(gen_data) > 19 else 0,
                'apf': gen_data[20] if len(gen_data) > 20 else 0,
            })

        # Parse branches
        self.branches = []
        for branch_data in self.network.get('branch', []):
            branch = {
                'from_bus': int(branch_data[0]),
                'to_bus': int(branch_data[1]),
                'r': branch_data[2],  # resistance
                's': branch_data[3],  # reactance
                'b': branch_data[4],  # susceptance
                'rateA': branch_data[5] if branch_data[5] > 0 else 999,  # MVA limit
                'rateB': branch_data[6] if branch_data[6] > 0 else 999,
                'rateC': branch_data[7] if branch_data[7] > 0 else 999,
                'ratio': branch_data[8] if len(branch_data) > 8 else 0,  # turns ratio
                'angle': branch_data[9] if len(branch_data) > 9 else 0,  # phase shift (deg)
                'status': int(branch_data[10]) if len(branch_data) > 10 else 1,
                'angmin': branch_data[11] if len(branch_data) > 11 else -60,
                'angmax': branch_data[12] if len(branch_data) > 12 else 60,
            }
            if branch['status'] == 1:
                self.branches.append(branch)

        self.n_branches = len(self.branches)

        # Parse generator cost data if available
        self.gen_costs = {}
        for cost_data in self.network.get('gencost', []):
            gen_idx = int(cost_data[0]) - 1
            if cost_data[1] == 2:  # polynomial cost
                n_coeffs = int(cost_data[2])
                coeffs = cost_data[3:][:n_coeffs]
                # Store as quadratic: [c2, c1, c0]
                if n_coeffs >= 3:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = coeffs[-3:]
                elif n_coeffs == 2:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = [0, coeffs[-2], coeffs[-1]]
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = [0, 0, coeffs[-1] if n_coeffs > 0 else 0]

    def _initialize_variables(self):
        """Initialize optimization variables"""
        # Flatten generator list
        self.gen_list = []
        gen_map = {}
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            if bus_id in self.generators:
                for gen in self.generators[bus_id]:
                    gen_idx = len(self.gen_list)
                    self.gen_list.append((bus_id, gen['id']))
                    gen_map[(bus_id, gen['id'])] = gen_idx

        self.gen_map = gen_map
        self.n_gens = len(self.gen_list)

        # Reference buses (slack buses)
        self.ref_buses = [bid for bid in self.bus_list if self.buses[bid]['type'] == 3]
        if not self.ref_buses:
            self.ref_buses = [self.bus_list[0]]

    def solve(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        # Initial point: use bus voltages as init, generators at mid-range
        x0 = self._get_initial_point()

        # Bounds
        bounds = self._get_bounds()

        # Constraints
        constraints = self._get_constraints()

        # Objective function
        def objective(x):
            return self._objective(x)

        # Solve
        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6}
        )

        return self._extract_solution(result, x0)

    def _get_initial_point(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """Get initial point for optimization"""
        # Variables: [pg_0, qg_0, ..., pg_n, qg_n, vm_0, va_0, ..., vm_n, va_n]
        x = []

        # Generator powers
        for bus_id, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            gen = self.generators[bus_id][gen_id]
            # Start at mid-range
            p_mid = (gen['pmin'] + gen['pmax']) / 2
            q_mid = (gen['qmin'] + gen['qmax']) / 2
            x.append(p_mid)
            x.append(q_mid)

        # Bus voltages
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            x.append(bus['vm'])  # voltage magnitude
            x.append(bus['va'])  # voltage angle

        return np.array(x)

    def _get_bounds(self) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:
        """Get variable bounds"""
        bounds = []

        # Generator power bounds
        for bus_id, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            gen = self.generators[bus_id][gen_id]
            bounds.append((gen['pmin'], gen['pmax']))  # Pg
            bounds.append((gen['qmin'], gen['qmax']))  # Qg

        # Voltage bounds
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            bounds.append((bus['vmin'], bus['vmax']))  # Vm
            bounds.append((-180, 180))  # Va (degrees)

        return bounds

    def _get_constraints(self) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get constraint functions"""
        constraints = []

        # Slack bus angle = 0
        for ref_bus in self.ref_buses:
            bus_idx = self.bus_idx[ref_bus]
            var_idx = self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2 + 1

            def slack_constraint(x, var_idx=var_idx):
                return x[var_idx]

            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': slack_constraint
            })

        # Power balance constraints
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            def power_balance(x, bus_id=bus_id):
                return self._power_balance_constraint(x, bus_id)

            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': power_balance
            })

        return constraints

    def _power_balance_constraint(self, x: np.ndarray, bus_id: int) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """
        Power balance constraint: Pg - Pd = Pflow
        Returns both real and reactive power mismatch
        """
        bus_idx = self.bus_idx[bus_id]

        # Get generator power at this bus
        pg = 0.0
        qg = 0.0
        for bid, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            if bid == bus_id:
                gen_idx = self.gen_map[(bid, gen_id)]
                pg += x[gen_idx * 2]
                qg += x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]

        # Get load
        pd = self.buses[bus_id]['pd']
        qd = self.buses[bus_id]['qd']

        # Get shunt
        gs = self.buses[bus_id]['gs']
        bs = self.buses[bus_id]['bs']
        vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2]

        p_shunt = gs * vm * vm
        q_shunt = -bs * vm * vm

        # Get voltage
        va = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2 + 1])
        v = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate branch flows
        p_flow = 0.0
        q_flow = 0.0

        for branch in self.branches:
            from_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['from_bus'])
            to_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['to_bus'])

            if from_idx is None or to_idx is None:
                continue

            if branch['from_bus'] == bus_id:
                # Flow from this bus
                vm_to = x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2]
                va_to = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2 + 1])
                v_to = vm_to * np.exp(1j * va_to)

                # Series admittance
                z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
                y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
                b = branch['b']

                # Shunt at from end
                yc_from = 1j * b / 2

                # Tap ratio
                t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                if branch['angle'] != 0:
                    t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

                # Power flow from->to
                v_norm = v / t if t != 0 else v
                s = (y + yc_from) * (v_norm * np.conj(v_norm)) - y * v_norm * np.conj(v_to)

                p_flow += s.real
                q_flow += s.imag

            elif branch['to_bus'] == bus_id:
                # Flow to this bus
                vm_from = x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2]
                va_from = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2 + 1])
                v_from = vm_from * np.exp(1j * va_from)

                # Series admittance
                z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
                y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
                b = branch['b']

                # Shunt at to end
                yc_to = 1j * b / 2

                # Tap ratio
                t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                if branch['angle'] != 0:
                    t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

                # Power flow to<-from
                s = (y + yc_to) * (v * np.conj(v)) - y * v * np.conj(v_from / t)

                p_flow += s.real
                q_flow += s.imag

        # Balance equation: Pg - Pd - Pshunt = Pflow
        # Return as single value (prioritize real power)
        p_mismatch = pg - pd - p_shunt - p_flow
        q_mismatch = qg - qd - q_shunt - q_flow

        # Return weighted sum to keep both in check
        return p_mismatch * 1.0 + q_mismatch * 0.1

    def _objective(self, x: np.ndarray) -> float:
        """Objective function: minimize generation cost"""
        cost = 0.0
        gen_counter = 0

        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            if bus_id not in self.generators:
                continue

            for gen in self.generators[bus_id]:
                pg = x[gen_counter * 2]

                # Get cost coefficients
                cost_key = gen_counter
                if cost_key in self.gen_costs:
                    c2, c1, c0 = self.gen_costs[cost_key]
                else:
                    # Default: linear cost
                    c2, c1, c0 = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0

                cost += c2 * pg * pg + c1 * pg + c0

                gen_counter += 1

        return cost

    def _extract_solution(self, opt_result, x0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Extract solution from optimizer result"""
        x = opt_result.x if opt_result.success else x0

        # Extract voltages
        voltages = {}
        for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_list):
            vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
            va = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2 + 1]
            voltages[bus_id] = {'vm': vm, 'va': va}

        # Extract generator dispatch
        gen_dispatch = {}
        for gen_idx, (bus_id, gen_id) in enumerate(self.gen_list):
            pg = x[gen_idx * 2]
            qg = x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]
            if bus_id not in gen_dispatch:
                gen_dispatch[bus_id] = []
            gen_dispatch[bus_id].append({'pg': pg, 'qg': qg})

        # Calculate summary statistics
        total_cost = self._objective(x)
        total_gen_p = sum(pg for pg, _ in [(x[i * 2], x[i * 2 + 1]) for i in range(self.n_gens)])
        total_gen_q = sum(qg for _, qg in [(x[i * 2], x[i * 2 + 1]) for i in range(self.n_gens)])

        total_load_p = sum(self.buses[bid]['pd'] for bid in self.bus_list)
        total_load_q = sum(self.buses[bid]['qd'] for bid in self.bus_list)

        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        # Calculate most loaded branches
        most_loaded = self._get_most_loaded_branches(x)

        # Feasibility check
        feasibility = self._check_feasibility(x, opt_result)

        return {
            'success': opt_result.success,
            'x': x,
            'voltages': voltages,
            'gen_dispatch': gen_dispatch,
            'total_cost': total_cost,
            'total_gen_p': total_gen_p,
            'total_gen_q': total_gen_q,
            'total_load_p': total_load_p,
            'total_load_q': total_load_q,
            'total_losses_p': total_losses_p,
            'most_loaded': most_loaded,
            'feasibility': feasibility,
        }

    def _get_most_loaded_branches(self, x: np.ndarray, top_n: int = 10) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get most loaded branches"""
        branch_loadings = []

        for branch in self.branches:
            from_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['from_bus'])
            to_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['to_bus'])

            if from_idx is None or to_idx is None:
                continue

            vm_from = x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2]
            va_from = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2 + 1])
            v_from = vm_from * np.exp(1j * va_from)

            vm_to = x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2]
            va_to = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2 + 1])
            v_to = vm_to * np.exp(1j * va_to)

            # Calculate power flow
            z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
            y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
            b = branch['b']
            yc_from = 1j * b / 2

            t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
            if branch['angle'] != 0:
                t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

            v_norm = v_from / t if t != 0 else v_from
            s_from = (y + yc_from) * (v_norm * np.conj(v_norm)) - y * v_norm * np.conj(v_to)
            s_mva_from = np.abs(s_from)

            # Calculate return flow
            yc_to = 1j * b / 2
            s_to = (y + yc_to) * (v_to * np.conj(v_to)) - y * v_to * np.conj(v_from / t)
            s_mva_to = np.abs(s_to)

            limit = branch['rateA']
            loading_pct = max(s_mva_from, s_mva_to) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

            branch_loadings.append({
                'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
                'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': s_mva_from,
                'flow_to_MVA': s_mva_to,
                'limit_MVA': limit,
            })

        # Sort by loading percentage and return top N
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        return branch_loadings[:top_n]

    def _check_feasibility(self, x: np.ndarray, opt_result) -> Dict:
        """Check solution feasibility"""
        max_p_mismatch = 0.0
        max_q_mismatch = 0.0
        max_voltage_viol = 0.0
        max_branch_overload = 0.0

        # Check voltage limits
        for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_list):
            vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            if vm < bus['vmin']:
                max_voltage_viol = max(max_voltage_viol, bus['vmin'] - vm)
            elif vm > bus['vmax']:
                max_voltage_viol = max(max_voltage_viol, vm - bus['vmax'])

        # Check power balance
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            pg = 0.0
            qg = 0.0
            for bid, gen_id in self.gen_list:
                if bid == bus_id:
                    gen_idx = self.gen_map[(bid, gen_id)]
                    pg += x[gen_idx * 2]
                    qg += x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]

            pd = self.buses[bus_id]['pd']
            qd = self.buses[bus_id]['qd']

            max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, abs(pg - pd))
            max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, abs(qg - qd))

        # Check branch limits
        for branch_loading in self._get_most_loaded_branches(x, top_n=len(self.branches)):
            if branch_loading['loading_pct'] > 100:
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload,
                                         branch_loading['loading_pct'] - 100)

        return {
            'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
            'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
            'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_voltage_viol, 6),
            'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_branch_overload, 2),
        }


def main():
    """Main function"""
    print("Solving AC Optimal Power Flow...")

    solver = OPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    solution = solver.solve()

    print(f"Solver Status: {'Optimal' if solution['success'] else 'Failed'}")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${solution['total_cost']:.2f}")
    print(f"Total Generation: {solution['total_gen_p']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Load: {solution['total_load_p']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Losses: {solution['total_losses_p']:.2f} MW")

    # Generate report
    report = generate_report(solver, solution)

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\nReport saved to /root/report.json")


def generate_report(solver: OPFSolver, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the final report"""
    x = solution['x']

    # Generators list
    generators = []
    gen_counter = 0
    for bus_id in solver.bus_list:
        if bus_id not in solver.generators:
            continue
        for gen_idx, gen in enumerate(solver.generators[bus_id]):
            pg = x[gen_counter * 2]
            qg = x[gen_counter * 2 + 1]

            generators.append({
                'id': gen['id'],
                'bus': gen['bus'],
                'pg_MW': round(pg, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(qg, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(gen['pmin'], 1),
                'pmax_MW': round(gen['pmax'], 1),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(gen['qmin'], 1),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(gen['qmax'], 1),
            })
            gen_counter += 1

    # Buses list
    buses = []
    for i, bus_id in enumerate(solver.bus_list):
        vm = x[solver.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
        va = x[solver.n_gens * 2 + i * 2 + 1]
        bus = solver.buses[bus_id]

        buses.append({
            'id': bus_id,
            'vm_pu': round(vm, 2),
            'va_deg': round(va, 1),
            'vmin_pu': round(bus['vmin'], 2),
            'vmax_pu': round(bus['vmax'], 2),
        })

    # Most loaded branches
    most_loaded = solution['most_loaded'][:10]  # Top 10
    for branch in most_loaded:
        branch['loading_pct'] = round(branch['loading_pct'], 1)
        branch['flow_from_MVA'] = round(branch['flow_from_MVA'], 1)
        branch['flow_to_MVA'] = round(branch['flow_to_MVA'], 1)
        branch['limit_MVA'] = round(branch['limit_MVA'], 1)

    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(solution['total_cost'], 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(solution['total_load_p'], 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(solution['total_load_q'], 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(solution['total_gen_p'], 2),
            'total_generation_MVAr': round(solution['total_gen_q'], 2),
            'total_losses_MW': round(solution['total_losses_p'], 2),
            'solver_status': 'optimal' if solution['success'] else 'failed',
        },
        'generators': generators,
        'buses': buses,
        'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
        'feasibility_check': solution['feasibility'],
    }

    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Optimal Power Flow (OPF) Solver for AC-feasible base case
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, lil_matrix
from scipy.sparse.linalg import spsolve
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Any
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')


class OPFSolver:
    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver - Fast implementation"""

    def __init__(self, network_file: str):
        """Initialize OPF solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.network = json.load(f)

        self.base_mva = self.network.get('baseMVA', 100.0)
        self._parse_network()

    def _parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data from JSON"""
        # Parse buses
        self.buses = {}
        for bus_data in self.network.get('bus', []):
            bus_id = int(bus_data[0])
            self.buses[bus_id] = {
                'type': int(bus_data[1]),
                'pd': bus_data[2],
                'qd': bus_data[3],
                'gs': bus_data[4],
                'bs': bus_data[5],
                'area': int(bus_data[6]),
                'vm': bus_data[9],
                'va': bus_data[10],
                'vmax': bus_data[11],
                'vmin': bus_data[12],
            }

        self.n_buses = len(self.buses)
        self.bus_list = sorted(self.buses.keys())
        self.bus_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(self.bus_list)}

        # Parse generators
        self.generators = []
        for gen_data in self.network.get('gen', []):
            bus_id = int(gen_data[0])
            gen = {
                'bus': bus_id,
                'pg': gen_data[1],
                'qg': gen_data[2],
                'qmax': gen_data[3],
                'qmin': gen_data[4],
                'vg': gen_data[5],
                'mbase': gen_data[6],
                'status': int(gen_data[7]),
                'pmax': gen_data[8],
                'pmin': gen_data[9],
                'c2': gen_data[10] if len(gen_data) > 10 else 0.0,
                'c1': gen_data[11] if len(gen_data) > 11 else 1.0,
                'c0': gen_data[12] if len(gen_data) > 12 else 0.0,
            }
            self.generators.append(gen)

        self.n_gens = len(self.generators)

        # Parse branches
        self.branches = []
        for branch_data in self.network.get('branch', []):
            branch = {
                'from_bus': int(branch_data[0]),
                'to_bus': int(branch_data[1]),
                'r': branch_data[2],
                's': branch_data[3],
                'b': branch_data[4],
                'rateA': branch_data[5] if branch_data[5] > 0 else 9999,
                'rateB': branch_data[6] if branch_data[6] > 0 else 9999,

                'ramp_agc': gen_data[16] if len(gen_data) > 16 else 0,
                'ramp_10': gen_data[17] if len(gen_data) > 17 else 0,
                'ramp_30': gen_data[18] if len(gen_data) > 18 else 0,
                'ramp_q': gen_data[19] if len(gen_data) > 19 else 0,
                'apf': gen_data[20] if len(gen_data) > 20 else 0,
            })

        # Parse branches
        self.branches = []
        for branch_data in self.network.get('branch', []):
            branch = {
                'from_bus': int(branch_data[0]),
                'to_bus': int(branch_data[1]),
                'r': branch_data[2],  # resistance
                's': branch_data[3],  # reactance
                'b': branch_data[4],  # susceptance
                'rateA': branch_data[5] if branch_data[5] > 0 else 999,  # MVA limit
                'rateB': branch_data[6] if branch_data[6] > 0 else 999,
                'rateC': branch_data[7] if branch_data[7] > 0 else 999,
                'ratio': branch_data[8] if len(branch_data) > 8 else 0,  # turns ratio
                'angle': branch_data[9] if len(branch_data) > 9 else 0,  # phase shift (deg)
                'status': int(branch_data[10]) if len(branch_data) > 10 else 1,
                'angmin': branch_data[11] if len(branch_data) > 11 else -60,
                'angmax': branch_data[12] if len(branch_data) > 12 else 60,
            }
            if branch['status'] == 1:
                self.branches.append(branch)

        self.n_branches = len(self.branches)

        # Parse generator cost data if available
        self.gen_costs = {}
        for cost_data in self.network.get('gencost', []):
            gen_idx = int(cost_data[0]) - 1
            if cost_data[1] == 2:  # polynomial cost
                n_coeffs = int(cost_data[2])
                coeffs = cost_data[3:][:n_coeffs]
                # Store as quadratic: [c2, c1, c0]
                if n_coeffs >= 3:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = coeffs[-3:]
                elif n_coeffs == 2:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = [0, coeffs[-2], coeffs[-1]]
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_idx] = [0, 0, coeffs[-1] if n_coeffs > 0 else 0]

    def _initialize_variables(self):
        """Initialize optimization variables"""
        # Flatten generator list
        self.gen_list = []
        gen_map = {}
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            if bus_id in self.generators:
                for gen in self.generators[bus_id]:
                    gen_idx = len(self.gen_list)
                    self.gen_list.append((bus_id, gen['id']))
                    gen_map[(bus_id, gen['id'])] = gen_idx

        self.gen_map = gen_map
        self.n_gens = len(self.gen_list)

        # Reference buses (slack buses)
        self.ref_buses = [bid for bid in self.bus_list if self.buses[bid]['type'] == 3]
        if not self.ref_buses:
            self.ref_buses = [self.bus_list[0]]

    def solve(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        # Initial point: use bus voltages as init, generators at mid-range
        x0 = self._get_initial_point()

        # Bounds
        bounds = self._get_bounds()

        # Constraints
        constraints = self._get_constraints()

        # Objective function
        def objective(x):
            return self._objective(x)

        # Solve
        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6}
        )

        return self._extract_solution(result, x0)

    def _get_initial_point(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """Get initial point for optimization"""
        # Variables: [pg_0, qg_0, ..., pg_n, qg_n, vm_0, va_0, ..., vm_n, va_n]
        x = []

        # Generator powers
        for bus_id, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            gen = self.generators[bus_id][gen_id]
            # Start at mid-range
            p_mid = (gen['pmin'] + gen['pmax']) / 2
            q_mid = (gen['qmin'] + gen['qmax']) / 2
            x.append(p_mid)
            x.append(q_mid)

        # Bus voltages
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            x.append(bus['vm'])  # voltage magnitude
            x.append(bus['va'])  # voltage angle

        return np.array(x)

    def _get_bounds(self) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:
        """Get variable bounds"""
        bounds = []

        # Generator power bounds
        for bus_id, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            gen = self.generators[bus_id][gen_id]
            bounds.append((gen['pmin'], gen['pmax']))  # Pg
            bounds.append((gen['qmin'], gen['qmax']))  # Qg

        # Voltage bounds
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            bounds.append((bus['vmin'], bus['vmax']))  # Vm
            bounds.append((-180, 180))  # Va (degrees)

        return bounds

    def _get_constraints(self) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get constraint functions"""
        constraints = []

        # Slack bus angle = 0
        for ref_bus in self.ref_buses:
            bus_idx = self.bus_idx[ref_bus]
            var_idx = self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2 + 1

            def slack_constraint(x, var_idx=var_idx):
                return x[var_idx]

            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': slack_constraint
            })

        # Power balance constraints
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            def power_balance(x, bus_id=bus_id):
                return self._power_balance_constraint(x, bus_id)

            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': power_balance
            })

        return constraints

    def _power_balance_constraint(self, x: np.ndarray, bus_id: int) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """
        Power balance constraint: Pg - Pd = Pflow
        Returns both real and reactive power mismatch
        """
        bus_idx = self.bus_idx[bus_id]

        # Get generator power at this bus
        pg = 0.0
        qg = 0.0
        for bid, gen_id in self.gen_list:
            if bid == bus_id:
                gen_idx = self.gen_map[(bid, gen_id)]
                pg += x[gen_idx * 2]
                qg += x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]

        # Get load
        pd = self.buses[bus_id]['pd']
        qd = self.buses[bus_id]['qd']

        # Get shunt
        gs = self.buses[bus_id]['gs']
        bs = self.buses[bus_id]['bs']
        vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2]

        p_shunt = gs * vm * vm
        q_shunt = -bs * vm * vm

        # Get voltage
        va = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + bus_idx * 2 + 1])
        v = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate branch flows
        p_flow = 0.0
        q_flow = 0.0

        for branch in self.branches:
            from_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['from_bus'])
            to_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['to_bus'])

            if from_idx is None or to_idx is None:
                continue

            if branch['from_bus'] == bus_id:
                # Flow from this bus
                vm_to = x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2]
                va_to = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2 + 1])
                v_to = vm_to * np.exp(1j * va_to)

                # Series admittance
                z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
                y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
                b = branch['b']

                # Shunt at from end
                yc_from = 1j * b / 2

                # Tap ratio
                t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                if branch['angle'] != 0:
                    t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

                # Power flow from->to
                v_norm = v / t if t != 0 else v
                s = (y + yc_from) * (v_norm * np.conj(v_norm)) - y * v_norm * np.conj(v_to)

                p_flow += s.real
                q_flow += s.imag

            elif branch['to_bus'] == bus_id:
                # Flow to this bus
                vm_from = x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2]
                va_from = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2 + 1])
                v_from = vm_from * np.exp(1j * va_from)

                # Series admittance
                z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
                y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
                b = branch['b']

                # Shunt at to end
                yc_to = 1j * b / 2

                # Tap ratio
                t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                if branch['angle'] != 0:
                    t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

                # Power flow to<-from
                s = (y + yc_to) * (v * np.conj(v)) - y * v * np.conj(v_from / t)

                p_flow += s.real
                q_flow += s.imag

        # Balance equation: Pg - Pd - Pshunt = Pflow
        # Return as single value (prioritize real power)
        p_mismatch = pg - pd - p_shunt - p_flow
        q_mismatch = qg - qd - q_shunt - q_flow

        # Return weighted sum to keep both in check
        return p_mismatch * 1.0 + q_mismatch * 0.1

    def _objective(self, x: np.ndarray) -> float:
        """Objective function: minimize generation cost"""
        cost = 0.0
        gen_counter = 0

        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            if bus_id not in self.generators:
                continue

            for gen in self.generators[bus_id]:
                pg = x[gen_counter * 2]

                # Get cost coefficients
                cost_key = gen_counter
                if cost_key in self.gen_costs:
                    c2, c1, c0 = self.gen_costs[cost_key]
                else:
                    # Default: linear cost
                    c2, c1, c0 = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0

                cost += c2 * pg * pg + c1 * pg + c0

                gen_counter += 1

        return cost

    def _extract_solution(self, opt_result, x0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Extract solution from optimizer result"""
        x = opt_result.x if opt_result.success else x0

        # Extract voltages
        voltages = {}
        for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_list):
            vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
            va = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2 + 1]
            voltages[bus_id] = {'vm': vm, 'va': va}

        # Extract generator dispatch
        gen_dispatch = {}
        for gen_idx, (bus_id, gen_id) in enumerate(self.gen_list):
            pg = x[gen_idx * 2]
            qg = x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]
            if bus_id not in gen_dispatch:
                gen_dispatch[bus_id] = []
            gen_dispatch[bus_id].append({'pg': pg, 'qg': qg})

        # Calculate summary statistics
        total_cost = self._objective(x)
        total_gen_p = sum(pg for pg, _ in [(x[i * 2], x[i * 2 + 1]) for i in range(self.n_gens)])
        total_gen_q = sum(qg for _, qg in [(x[i * 2], x[i * 2 + 1]) for i in range(self.n_gens)])

        total_load_p = sum(self.buses[bid]['pd'] for bid in self.bus_list)
        total_load_q = sum(self.buses[bid]['qd'] for bid in self.bus_list)

        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        # Calculate most loaded branches
        most_loaded = self._get_most_loaded_branches(x)

        # Feasibility check
        feasibility = self._check_feasibility(x, opt_result)

        return {
            'success': opt_result.success,
            'x': x,
            'voltages': voltages,
            'gen_dispatch': gen_dispatch,
            'total_cost': total_cost,
            'total_gen_p': total_gen_p,
            'total_gen_q': total_gen_q,
            'total_load_p': total_load_p,
            'total_load_q': total_load_q,
            'total_losses_p': total_losses_p,
            'most_loaded': most_loaded,
            'feasibility': feasibility,
        }

    def _get_most_loaded_branches(self, x: np.ndarray, top_n: int = 10) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get most loaded branches"""
        branch_loadings = []

        for branch in self.branches:
            from_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['from_bus'])
            to_idx = self.bus_idx.get(branch['to_bus'])

            if from_idx is None or to_idx is None:
                continue

            vm_from = x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2]
            va_from = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + from_idx * 2 + 1])
            v_from = vm_from * np.exp(1j * va_from)

            vm_to = x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2]
            va_to = np.radians(x[self.n_gens * 2 + to_idx * 2 + 1])
            v_to = vm_to * np.exp(1j * va_to)

            # Calculate power flow
            z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['s']
            y = 1 / z if z != 0 else 0
            b = branch['b']
            yc_from = 1j * b / 2

            t = branch['ratio'] if branch['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
            if branch['angle'] != 0:
                t = t * np.exp(1j * np.radians(branch['angle']))

            v_norm = v_from / t if t != 0 else v_from
            s_from = (y + yc_from) * (v_norm * np.conj(v_norm)) - y * v_norm * np.conj(v_to)
            s_mva_from = np.abs(s_from)

            # Calculate return flow
            yc_to = 1j * b / 2
            s_to = (y + yc_to) * (v_to * np.conj(v_to)) - y * v_to * np.conj(v_from / t)
            s_mva_to = np.abs(s_to)

            limit = branch['rateA']
            loading_pct = max(s_mva_from, s_mva_to) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

            branch_loadings.append({
                'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
                'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': s_mva_from,
                'flow_to_MVA': s_mva_to,
                'limit_MVA': limit,
            })

        # Sort by loading percentage and return top N
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        return branch_loadings[:top_n]

    def _check_feasibility(self, x: np.ndarray, opt_result) -> Dict:
        """Check solution feasibility"""
        max_p_mismatch = 0.0
        max_q_mismatch = 0.0
        max_voltage_viol = 0.0
        max_branch_overload = 0.0

        # Check voltage limits
        for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_list):
            vm = x[self.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
            bus = self.buses[bus_id]
            if vm < bus['vmin']:
                max_voltage_viol = max(max_voltage_viol, bus['vmin'] - vm)
            elif vm > bus['vmax']:
                max_voltage_viol = max(max_voltage_viol, vm - bus['vmax'])

        # Check power balance
        for bus_id in self.bus_list:
            pg = 0.0
            qg = 0.0
            for bid, gen_id in self.gen_list:
                if bid == bus_id:
                    gen_idx = self.gen_map[(bid, gen_id)]
                    pg += x[gen_idx * 2]
                    qg += x[gen_idx * 2 + 1]

            pd = self.buses[bus_id]['pd']
            qd = self.buses[bus_id]['qd']

            max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, abs(pg - pd))
            max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, abs(qg - qd))

        # Check branch limits
        for branch_loading in self._get_most_loaded_branches(x, top_n=len(self.branches)):
            if branch_loading['loading_pct'] > 100:
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload,
                                         branch_loading['loading_pct'] - 100)

        return {
            'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
            'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
            'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_voltage_viol, 6),
            'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_branch_overload, 2),
        }


def main():
    """Main function"""
    print("Solving AC Optimal Power Flow...")

    solver = OPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    solution = solver.solve()

    print(f"Solver Status: {'Optimal' if solution['success'] else 'Failed'}")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${solution['total_cost']:.2f}")
    print(f"Total Generation: {solution['total_gen_p']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Load: {solution['total_load_p']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Losses: {solution['total_losses_p']:.2f} MW")

    # Generate report
    report = generate_report(solver, solution)

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\nReport saved to /root/report.json")


def generate_report(solver: OPFSolver, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the final report"""
    x = solution['x']

    # Generators list
    generators = []
    gen_counter = 0
    for bus_id in solver.bus_list:
        if bus_id not in solver.generators:
            continue
        for gen_idx, gen in enumerate(solver.generators[bus_id]):
            pg = x[gen_counter * 2]
            qg = x[gen_counter * 2 + 1]

            generators.append({
                'id': gen['id'],
                'bus': gen['bus'],
                'pg_MW': round(pg, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(qg, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(gen['pmin'], 1),
                'pmax_MW': round(gen['pmax'], 1),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(gen['qmin'], 1),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(gen['qmax'], 1),
            })
            gen_counter += 1

    # Buses list
    buses = []
    for i, bus_id in enumerate(solver.bus_list):
        vm = x[solver.n_gens * 2 + i * 2]
        va = x[solver.n_gens * 2 + i * 2 + 1]
        bus = solver.buses[bus_id]

        buses.append({
            'id': bus_id,
            'vm_pu': round(vm, 2),
            'va_deg': round(va, 1),
            'vmin_pu': round(bus['vmin'], 2),
            'vmax_pu': round(bus['vmax'], 2),
        })

    # Most loaded branches
    most_loaded = solution['most_loaded'][:10]  # Top 10
    for branch in most_loaded:
        branch['loading_pct'] = round(branch['loading_pct'], 1)
        branch['flow_from_MVA'] = round(branch['flow_from_MVA'], 1)
        branch['flow_to_MVA'] = round(branch['flow_to_MVA'], 1)
        branch['limit_MVA'] = round(branch['limit_MVA'], 1)

    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(solution['total_cost'], 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(solution['total_load_p'], 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(solution['total_load_q'], 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(solution['total_gen_p'], 2),
            'total_generation_MVAr': round(solution['total_gen_q'], 2),
            'total_losses_MW': round(solution['total_losses_p'], 2),
            'solver_status': 'optimal' if solution['success'] else 'failed',
        },
        'generators': generators,
        'buses': buses,
        'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
        'feasibility_check': solution['feasibility'],
    }

    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
